## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the completed slice and link its issue and requirements.

## Validation

Record exact commands, results, commit and independent blind reviewer verdict.

## Screenshots — required

Include before/after captures for affected desktop and phone surfaces. Non-UI changes require a capture of passing verification. Open and inspect every capture; describe any clipping, overlap, missing states or overflow and fix it before review.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Every issue criterion is met without narrowing scope.
- [ ] End-to-end behavior, persistence, permissions and failure states verified.
- [ ] Screenshots opened and inspected; independent blind review passed.
- [ ] Local, preview and production evidence are stated separately.
